decisions.reason: Selecting answer layers after finalizing the question set does not change the existing question-review count, removal criteria, curation actions, or streamlining goal.
The answer-layer change does not alter the separate checklist deliverable, its leadership focus, or its concise non-question-and-answer treatment.
The candidate state requires questions that candidates can ask interviewers but does not require layered answers, so the answer-layer decision does not necessarily change it.
Changing the available answer layers and applying them selectively does not alter the requirement to represent international differences across countries and industries.
The answer-layer decision does not change the AI chapter's mandatory status or its required coverage of prompts, techniques, and tools.
The answer-layer structure has no effect on the authoritative Google Doc, change-tracking method, or use of a PDF as reference.
The manuscript answer-layer change does not alter the companion-material deliverable, learning purpose, or listed non-video resource types.
The source decision governs selectable layers for answers after the existing question set is finalized and does not necessarily change the separate first-time-leader chapter's subject.
The answer-layer modification does not necessarily change the separate chapter requirement for remote and hybrid leadership interview questions.
Selective use of answer layers does not modify the fixed 110,000-word ceiling or the recorded approximate length of the existing edition.
